project_type: Python 3.12 agentic movie-intelligence system: pydantic domain/serving models, a Bedrock Converse agent loop, a DynamoDB single-table persistence layer, AWS CDK (Python) infra with Lambda handlers, and a vanilla ES (no build step) front end.
language: Python 3.12 (src + infra + tests); vanilla JavaScript (frontend/app.js, node --check only).
build_system: uv (astral) for Python deps/venv; hatchling build backend (packages=['src/movieintel']). CDK via `npx aws-cdk@2` run from infra/ (no global cdk). CDK Lambda layers use LOCAL bundling (uv pip install + copy) so synth needs no Docker. The code asset root is infra/ and handler strings are handlers.<pkg>.handler.handler so intra-handler `from handlers.shared import ...` resolves at runtime.
test_framework: pytest (pyproject [tool.pytest.ini_options]): pythonpath=['src','infra'], testpaths=['tests'], addopts='-q', marker 'live' skipped by default. moto (mock_aws) backs DynamoDB in tests. No JS test runner exists; frontend is validated with `node --check` only.
verification_instructions: Run the exact CI set from .github/workflows/ci.yml: `uv sync --dev`; `uv run ruff check .`; `uv run ruff format --check .`; `uv run mypy src`; `uv run pytest`. Then CDK synth from infra/: `cd infra && npx aws-cdk@2 synth MovieIntelServingStack` and `... MovieIntelPipelineStack`. Front end: `node --check frontend/app.js`. Regenerate OpenAPI before committing: `uv run python -m movieintel.serving.openapi`. ruff selects E,F,I,UP,B,SIM at line-length 100. mypy is strict with files=['src','tests','infra'] (local `uv run mypy` with no path checks all three) and mypy_path=['src','infra']; boto3/botocore have ignore_missing_imports.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/openapi.yaml is a generated artifact built from the pydantic serving models by `uv run python -m movieintel.serving.openapi`; tests/serving/test_openapi.py::test_on_disk_openapi_is_in_sync fails if it is stale. Regenerate it after any change to serving models or the generator and commit the result.
environment_constraints: Work ONLY inside the worktree /home/jacob/code/aetna/.worktrees/async-serving using ABSOLUTE paths; a relative path lands in the parent workspace /home/jacob/code/aetna. Branch is feature/async-serving. PRE-EXISTING, NOT-A-REGRESSION test failures: the _sqlite-absent cases in tests/data_access/ and test_extract_handler (gitignored source DBs are absent on base main) fail on the base branch too and MUST NOT be treated as new failures. uv, node, npx are on PATH. Never push.
contribution_requirements: AWS steering (user rules + design NFR-4): hyphens never em dashes in resource names/descriptions; IaC via CDK; least-privilege IAM (no bedrock:*, no Resource '*'); Well-Architected. The design doc at .agents/tasks/async-serving/design.md is the authority and must not be re-decided (OPTION C async + real per-phase progress are locked). Authoring only: do NOT merge or deploy.
key_patterns: Handlers use keyword-only dependency injection with optional deps defaulting to lazy boto3 builders (see infra/handlers/serve/handler.py) so pytest injects fakes and never builds a real client. Pydantic models are strict (ConfigDict(extra='forbid')) with a literal `kind` discriminator; AgentResult is a PEP 695 `type` alias union over five disjoint-kind models. DynamoDB has no float type: floats are stored as Decimal (see persistence/item.py _to_decimal and repository._as_number) and restored on read; the job store uses a generic JSON round-trip (_to_dynamo/_from_dynamo) instead. Single-table keys live in persistence/keys.py with typed prefixes (MOVIE#, SENTIMENT#). CDK synth tests use aws_cdk.assertions.Template.from_stack and match IAM/ARNs on stringified statements because the account id is a synth token.
directory_structure: src/movieintel/{agent,serving,persistence,enrichment,kb,domain,config.py,data_access,eval} is the installed package. infra/ holds the CDK app (app.py, pipeline_stack.py, serving_stack.py, constants.py) and the handlers/ package (serve/, enrich/, extract/, ... each with handler.py; shared/ to be created). tests/ mirrors with tests/{agent,serving,infra,data_access,...} and conftest fixtures reused across suites. docs/ holds openapi.yaml (generated) and examples/ (curl.sh, postman_collection.json). frontend/ is the static ES client (app.js, config.js, index.html).
